SM1_note_side_not_resolved._note: Note classes only normalized (the pre-9821a379 path) — a bare-uid note class never meets a resolved target.

SM2_target_side_not_resolved._note: targetClass only normalized — a Layout written with `[[uid]]` matches only bare-uid notes. S8 too: its Layout targets the bare uid.

SM3_resolver_option_dropped._note: The constructor ignores `options.resolveUid` — S3 survives (uid meets uid), every cross-form axis reddens. S8 too: same uid target, no resolver.

SM4_note_side_uid_wins._note: The alternative the review named (uid decides, alias only as a fallback) — deliberately NOT what RFC 9821a379 decision 4 specifies (resolveSymbolic = the codebase's alias-wins convention). Locks the chosen semantics.
